dsh-web-gateway.allowInternalUrlsDesc: Dangerous: permits extract targets that resolve to loopback/private addresses. Keep off unless you intentionally need it.
dsh-web-gateway.cacheTtlMsDesc: In-memory result cache lifetime. 0 disables caching.
dsh-web-gateway.circuitBreakerCooldownMsDesc: How long a provider stays paused after the failure threshold.
dsh-web-gateway.circuitBreakerThresholdDesc: Consecutive errors before temporarily pausing provider (0 disables).
dsh-web-gateway.compactExtractDesc: Strip cookie notices, nav noise and redundant formatting to save tokens.
dsh-web-gateway.crawl4aiUrlDesc: Optional crawl4ai extract fallback. Empty disables it.
dsh-web-gateway.dailyCapsDesc: 0 = unlimited. Counters reset each UTC calendar day.
dsh-web-gateway.diskCacheEnabledDesc: Persist results under the DSH profile so cache survives restarts.
dsh-web-gateway.diskCacheMaxEntriesDesc: Soft limit for on-disk cache entries.
dsh-web-gateway.egressProxyUrlDesc: Optional proxy URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8888) for SearXNG, DuckDuckGo, Crawl4AI & Readability.
dsh-web-gateway.extractDeadlineMsDesc: Wall-clock budget for one extract chain.
dsh-web-gateway.extractProviderOrderDesc: Comma-separated order. Allowed: firecrawl, tavily, crawl4ai, jina, readability.
dsh-web-gateway.firecrawlKeylessFetchDesc: Allow Firecrawl extract without a key. Public URLs are sent to Firecrawl cloud; disable to keep fetches local or keyed.
dsh-web-gateway.firecrawlKeylessSearchDesc: Allow Firecrawl search without an API key.
dsh-web-gateway.freeTierFirstDesc: Run every keyless free attempt before any keyed attempt.
dsh-web-gateway.freshnessDesc: any | day | week | month — applied when the provider supports it.
dsh-web-gateway.header_desc: Free-tier-first fallback web search (Firecrawl keyless → Keenable keyless → SearXNG → DuckDuckGo → Firecrawl → Keenable → Tavily → Brave → Exa) and page extract when built-in web_search / web_fetch hit limits.
dsh-web-gateway.includeDomainsDesc: Comma-separated allowlist for search results (empty = all).
dsh-web-gateway.jinaEnabledDesc: Keyless extract via r.jina.ai (respect their rate limits / ToS).
dsh-web-gateway.keenableEnabledDesc: Keyless search, plus the keyed endpoint when a key exists.
dsh-web-gateway.keysDesc: Store secret values in Settings → Credentials under these names. Do not paste API keys here.
dsh-web-gateway.maxLimitDesc: Maximum results one search call may return.
dsh-web-gateway.parallelMaxConcurrencyDesc: Max concurrent providers in race or aggregate mode (1–6).
dsh-web-gateway.readabilityEnabledDesc: Last-resort keyless extract by stripping HTML tags.
dsh-web-gateway.searchDeadlineMsDesc: Wall-clock budget for one search chain.
dsh-web-gateway.searchProviderOrderDesc: Comma-separated order. Allowed: firecrawl, keenable, searxng, duckduckgo, tavily, brave, exa.
dsh-web-gateway.searxngUrlDesc: Optional local SearXNG (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080). Empty disables this fallback.
dsh-web-gateway.settings.unavailable: Settings scope unavailable (host namespace is not ready).
dsh-web-gateway.subtitle: Resilient web search & extract fallback chain
dsh-web-gateway.title: Web Gateway
dsh-web-gateway.updater_success: Updated. Restart DSH to load the new version.
dsh-web-gateway.updater_unavailable: Automatic updates unavailable for this profile.
